Chris (CEO): Quick weekly — short read. Top-line: private beta hit 50 customers, p95 latency down ~12% week-over-week, cost/unit down ~7% from batching + quantization wins. Two asks below.
Maya (VP Product): Nice momentum. Can we get a brief customer-facing note outlining beta limits + known issues?
Chris (CEO): Yes — Maya, own the comms. Need a draft by Wed EOD. Also: prepare GA checklist items.
Jordan (Head of Eng): From eng: please freeze model-config changes during the canary. Proposed rollout: canary 10% Tue 09:00 PT, 50% Thu, full Fri. Rollback threshold: >1% error-rate or >20% latency regression on p95.
Priya (SRE): Incident recap: last Thu we had a retry storm traced to a KV-cache eviction race during long sessions. Patch deployed 03:12 UTC and stabilized traffic. Residual risk: rare race on conversations >30k tokens. Mitigation: short-circuit prefix caching for sessions >30k tokens and add alert for cache-rejection spikes.
Chris (CEO): Priya — make that mitigation enabled for the canary by default and add the alert to the critical dashboard.
Maya (VP Product): Policy update: hosted API default data-retention will move to 90 days (from 365) to match stricter EU customer requests; enterprise customers can request custom retention via contract. Security/legal review starts Friday.
Chris (CEO): Legal + Security must sign off before public announcement. Maya, loop them in and cc me on the first draft.
Jordan (Head of Eng): I can author the canary + rollback playbook if Maya wants me to. Also will include automated canary gates in deploy pipeline.
Maya (VP Product): Please do, Jordan — happy to review.
DevOps Bot: deploy/canary initiated by Jordan at 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z — status: initializing.
Priya (SRE): SLO reminder: keep 99.95% for requests <8s. Any change that risks tail should go through ops review 48h in advance.
Chris (CEO): Final asks for the week: 1) Eng — canary+rollback playbook by Mon EOD; 2) Product — customer comms draft + legal looped by Wed EOD; 3) SRE/Sec — sign-off on retention policy and ensure mitigation is live for canary. I'll host a 15-min follow-up Wed 10:00 PT to check blockers. Thanks team :simple_smile:
Maya (VP Product): Noted — will share calendar invite and draft link.
Jordan (Head of Eng): On it.
Priya (SRE): Dashboards updated; will post links when stable.
Chris (CEO): Appreciate the quick turn. Small, clear wins this week — keep the focus.
